prompts:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production artwork for a 4:3 animated livestream scene, high resolution 2048x1536 if possible. Make ONE polished complete anime illustration, no panels, labels, words, UI or watermark.
References: image 1 is camera-angle / seated car-pose reference only, not the man's identity. Image 2 is Astra's appearance and subtle cute expression reference. Image 3 is Astra's cute adult character design. Image 4 is DeepSeek character design. Image 5 is Claude character design. Ignore all text in references.
Scene: a cozy elegant lavender-and-cream car interior, ALL hand-painted anime style including car and scenery, absolutely no photorealism. Passenger-seat camera looking diagonally toward Astra in driver's seat on left/center; steering wheel at right foreground, windshield and dashboard visible to upper right, pastel countryside outside, soft warm daytime light. Clear spatially coherent seats, door, steering column, dashboard, windows.
Astra: cute stylized ADULT silver dragon woman, white-silver long hair, lavender eyes, small paired curved pale horns, pointed elf ears, braided silver knot hair ornament and tassel, elegant modest white high-collar dress with lavender trim. Compact folded wings behind shoulders that fit inside seat, not clipping car. Wearing a properly routed seatbelt. Face looking DIRECTLY toward camera, level and nearly frontal, both eyes visible, a quiet small closed-mouth smile, no hands or hair obscuring her eyes/mouth. Large expressive face around left-center upper third, enough detail for live face animation; flat softly shaded skin around eyes and mouth.
Exactly two anatomically coherent arms: the arm nearer the wheel comfortably bent with ONE hand visibly gripping the side of the steering wheel, believable fingers around rim. The other arm extends naturally toward camera, forearm foreshortened toward bottom-left corner, only HALF of that hand visible cropped by lower frame edge, like the user's pose reference. Only one fixed seated body gesture. Fully connected shoulders/elbows/wrists, no extra limbs, no floating hands, wheel grip contact correct.
DeepSeek and Claude: miniature cute chibi mascots seated side-by-side on small dashboard cushions directly BELOW the windshield on right, away from steering wheel. DeepSeek blue long hair, blue eyes, whale maid outfit and small whale tail; Claude orange long hair, amber eyes, cream-and-black dress with flower-and-bow accessory, little closed book in lap. BOTH looking at camera with open eyes, both clearly sitting with knees bent and little feet over dashboard edge; clear contact shadows, no floating. Much smaller than Astra, complete visible heads.
Composition: landscape 4:3, car fills frame edge-to-edge. Astra large left/center, two little seated mascots upper right below windshield, steering wheel lower right, foreground cropped hand lower left. All three distinct cute faces visible. Elegant crisp thin lines, beautiful detailed cel shading, silver-lavender pastel palette with blue and apricot accents. No random sparkles drawn across faces. Keep bottom center a quiet area for subtitles.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached car scene. Production animation clean plate. Keep EXACT same 1448x1086 canvas, pixel-aligned framing, composition, all characters, body poses, hands, car, colors, lighting and hair. Change ONLY the main silver-haired woman's TWO EYES and small MOUTH: remove their painted iris, sclera, eyelash and lip line, replacing those three little areas with smoothly matched surrounding face skin. Keep eyebrows, nose, facial silhouette and every hair strand exactly where they are. Do not change the blue-haired or orange-haired mascots at all. This is a technical blank facial plate for runtime animation, not a redesigned picture. The skin should extend smoothly through the removed eyes and mouth, preserving subtle original pink shading. No other changes, no new facial features, no text.
